blocked_positive_ev_sides.dispersion_review_update: the pregame MODEL_MARKET_DISPERSION_REVIEW flagged 9 of 10 positive-EV sides as underdogs and 9 of 10 totals as OVER. Both leans now look like model bias on this slate: the underdog sides went 0-7 and the champion averaged 0.52 runs UNDER realised totals. One slate, descriptive, but the review now has its first data point.
blocked_positive_ev_sides.reading: one slate validates nothing — a 0-7 on seven correlated underdog-leaning sides is a plausible single-slate outcome under many models. What it shows vividly is the asymmetry: raw EV without an error estimate would have authorized seven losing wagers. The uncertainty rule is not thereby proven; the cost of not having one is thereby illustrated.

champion_totals.note: bias -0.52: the champion projected UNDER the realised totals on average this slate, the opposite direction from the pregame 9-of-10-over lean vs the MARKET lines — different comparators, not a contradiction.

wnba_diagnostic.reading: the 33-day-stale shadow did not beat the winner prior and missed both totals badly — consistent with every flag it carried.
